name: shoji
description: A Quarto reveal.js slide theme in plum, pale gray and dusty blue, drawn from the Shoji PowerPoint design: 4px rules, a shallow title band, a narrow seam and tight margins, set at 28px on a 1280×720 canvas, with cards, callouts, stats, numbered steps, compared columns and half-bleed picture layouts. Suits text- and code-heavy decks.
